MapNotes.GMOnly: Only a GM can place the King's map notes.
MapNotes.NoPack: The Points of Interest Adventure is missing. Run npm run build.
MapNotes.WrongScene: {scene} is not the region map (275 px hex rows), so the King's map notes can't go there.
MapNotes.NoScene: This world has no region map (275 px hex rows). Import one, then place the King's map notes.
MapNotes.ManyScenes: This world has {count} region maps. View the one to mark, then place the King's map notes.
MapNotes.Placed: Placed {count} of the King's map notes on {scene}.
MapNotes.Merged: Moved the King's sites into the {journal} journal and deleted the {count} entries it replaces.
MapNotes.SceneNotes: Added a journal note to {count} of the Points of Interest scenes.
MapNotes.Tiled: Players now see the King's map notes on {scene} as art; only the GM sees the pins.

Reveals.Grip: Drag to move the panel; double-click to fold it

Influence.Grip: Drag to move the tracker; double-click to fold it
Influence.Apply: Apply this modifier to the Influence checks it covers
Influence.Shifted: DC changed by {by} from the modifiers in force
Influence.ResetPrompt: Reset the Influence tracker for {name}? Influence, the round and every revealed entry return to the start, and players stop seeing it.

SceneLinks.Missing: This scene is missing from the Points of Interest Adventure. Run npm run build.
SceneLinks.WholeMaps: Players now see the whole map on {count} of the Points of Interest scenes: token vision is off, and {hidden} creature and hazard tokens are hidden.

Actors.Failed: These actors could not load their stat blocks from the PF2e system and stay as name and art only: {names}. Check that the PF2e system is up to date; the module retries on the next world load.
Actors.RebuildPrompt: The updated module changed {count} actors in this world: {names}. Rebuild them? Rebuilding replaces each one whole, so current Hit Points, conditions and effects reset.
